title: Practice 2: Verbs that take the instrumental

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: I pride myself on my humility.
exercises.why: The object following this verb is in the Instrumental case: *Они пользуются всеми правами. Я часто пользуюсь его словарём.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 30, 65, 66, 99.  ·  «After the verbs командовать and заведовать the units or persons being commanded … are denoted by the instrumental case.» «This verb (заниматься) may be followed by the Instrumental case.» «The object following this verb (пользоваться) is in the Instrumental case.» — DLI, Lessons 30, 65, 99.
exercises.context: The object following this verb is in the Instrumental case: *Они пользуются всеми правами.
